notes: Strongest pricing evidence in the dataset alongside Kokkari — the brochure publishes per-space lunch/dinner minimums. CAVEAT: the PDF is filed under /2019/05/ in the WordPress uploads path, so these dollar figures are likely several years stale and should be treated as a floor, not a quote. The two- and three-bay minimums ($5,000 / $7,500) are stated by the brochure as per-bay pricing multiplied out; the brochure itself only prints the single-bay rate. Private Dining Room (35 seated, fully private, $3,000 dinner min) is the target-fit option for 30. Events contact named as Christine Chaffin; no phone/email published in the brochure. Slightly further south than the core FiDi cluster but still well inside a 15-minute commute.
